findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Notation/Indicator.lean:52-54`: `noncomputable def mulIndicator ... := haveI := Classical.decPred (· ∈ s); if x ∈ s then f x else 1`; `Set.indicator_apply`/`indicator_of_mem`/`indicator_of_notMem` exist (e.g. `mathlib/Mathlib/Probability/Process/Stopping.lean:1124-1138`).

findings.evidence: Lines 122-127: `by_cases ha ... <;> by_cases hb' ... <;> simp_all [Prod.ext_iff, lt_iff_le_and_ne] <;> grind` then `simp [Finsupp.sum, ...]` / `split_ifs <;> simp_all`.

findings.issue: Non-terminal unconstrained `simp [...]` followed by `split_ifs <;> simp_all`: whether an `if` survives for `split_ifs` depends entirely on the normal form the default simp set happens to leave, so any simp-set change breaks the step. The preceding calc step (lines 122-124) is a 16-way `by_cases` closed by `simp_all [...] <;> grind` with no indication which branches carry content.

findings.evidence: `code/TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex/Product.lean:357,363` define the abstract `image_fst_mem_of_mem_orderedProd`/`image_snd_mem_of_mem_orderedProd`; grep over `code/TauCeti` shows no use of either (only the precomplex versions at lines 158/174 and `isChain_of_mem_orderedProd` at Realization/Product.lean:87-88 are used).
findings.fix: Construct each map as `⟨Prod.fst, fun _ h ↦ ...image_fst_mem_of_mem_orderedProd ...⟩` (and `Prod.snd` dually) from the abstract lemmas, dropping the `let` indirection, the transport `simpa`s, and the comment that exists only to explain them.
findings.issue: `orderedProdRealizationMap` builds the two simplicial maps by re-wrapping `PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.orderedProdFst/Snd` and transporting each face proof with `simpa only [orderedProd_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex] using h`; the abstract-level lemmas added by this PR that discharge these obligations directly are never used.

summary: The new uniqueness file leans on definitional unfolding of `Set.indicator` and `Finsupp.sum`, a non-terminal unconstrained `simp` followed by `split_ifs <;> simp_all`, and duplicates a symmetric 20-line argument that is independently reusable with weaker hypotheses. The realization definition discharges its face obligations by an opaque transport instead of the abstract lemmas this PR adds.
